brief:
## Summary

Checkout integration tests (`checkout.spec.ts`) have been flaky for the past week, failing roughly 1 in 15 CI runs with payment-webhook timeout errors.

## Root cause

Confirmed against the staging payment gateway stub: under load, the stub silently drops about 2% of webhook callbacks, which the test suite interprets as a timeout.

## Open items

- Whether to quarantine the flaky specs now or block merges until the stub is fixed.
- Whether a larger CI runner class would also help with intermittent timeouts.

## Links

- [MR #301](https://gitlab.com/acme/checkout/-/merge_requests/301) adds verbose webhook logging for further diagnosis.
